description: Details pursuant to condition 5 (Construction Method statement), of Full Planning Permission reference 25/1390 dated 20/08/2025 for Change of use from Bank (Class E) to a mixed-use comprising ground floor and basement levels commercial unit (Class E) and 6 x self-contained flats, with alterations to shopfront with creation of entrance door direct to the commercial unit, retention of existing entrance door to access the residential accommodation, alterations to rear extension, third floor dormer extension, alterations to fenestration, installation of mezzanine level between ground and first floor, installation of rear balconies to the mezzanine, first, second and third floor flats, removal of existing external staircase and replacement with new external rear staircase with cycle hoist, erection of cycle store at the basement level and cycle storage spaces
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
